The small card represents Luna's claimed cost relationship; no text, logos or numbers appear in the image. This makes the price-versus-performance tension visible before the reader sees the detail.

paid_output.final_caption:
Главное за неделю в мире ИИ и технологий — без лишнего шума.

OpenAI запустила GPT-6 Sol и Luna: компания заявляет, что Luna соответствует GPT-5.6 Sol примерно за 1% его стоимости, а Sol совершает примерно вдвое меньше ошибок, чем GPT-5.6 Sol.

Параллельно цифровые водительские удостоверения расширяются в Apple Wallet, для древнегреческого готовят Apollo на 600 миллионах исторических слов, vivo показала Watch 6 от $149, Xiaomi открыла веса серии MiMo-V2.6, а Claude Code получил поддержку AGENTS.md.

Сохрани подборку — технологии снова ускорились сразу в нескольких направлениях.

creative_execution_plan.main_idea: A week of technology told as six concrete objects and transitions on one editorial desk: cost, access, language, hardware, openness and instructions.
creative_execution_plan.focal_point: The opening cost-versus-performance contrast around Luna, followed by one distinct visual anchor for each news story.
creative_execution_plan.media_rationale: Most available source assets are text-dominated cards, so generated contextual visuals give each story an honest, story-specific image; the Apollo source image is strong enough to retain.
creative_execution_plan.composition_direction: Use controlled variation across dark and light surfaces: oversized type beside large generated objects, one full-frame source image, then a compact flow diagram to close. Keep every visual concrete, blank of invented text, and tied to its story.
creative_execution_plan.branding_treatment: Small canonical logo in alternating safe corners, restrained red on editorial utility slides, and violet/magenta neo accents only where the technology metaphor benefits from them.
creative_execution_plan.visual_treatment: Documentary editorial still life with physical scale contrasts, open containers, transfers and directional movement. Generated scenes share portrait framing, clean studio light and unbranded objects;ّ
creative_execution_plan.avoid_recent_treatment: No recent Instagram content is available, so no specific treatment needs avoiding.

visual_rhythm.arc: Start with the week's sharpest price contrast, move through increasingly tangible stories and finish by compressing the six themes into one saveable takeaway.
visual_rhythm.repetition_note: Generated visuals repeat one editorial still-life language intentionally, while alternating surface, scale and composition to keep each story distinct.
